Hi Leigh,

did you check row 67330 in recordsF? From the error message it seems like that one record is causing the problems. If the date format is correct in that row, it may have to do with daylight saving time. If the date/time of that record is during the non-existent hour in which the clock is advanced from 2 to 3 am, it will be NA. In that case, adjusting the time zone helps. It is mentioned in the vignette also.

Usually camera traps don't correct for DST. So if you tell the detectionHistory function that the time zone has DST (and your images ignore DST), you may end up with this problem.

For the second issue, are you using the development version of camtrapR? Even if you do, please reinstall and see if the problem persists. The error seems wrong since SR11 does not even have entries in the problem columns.

library(devtools)

install_github("jniedballa/camtrapR", ref = "dev")

Please let me know if the error persists, then I need to investigate more. In that case please feel free to share a small reproducible example.

Thank you,

Jürgen
